mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_api_calls ( id, user_id, feature, operation, correlation_id, trace_id, provider, model, status, request_payload, response_payload, error_payload, candidate_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cached_input_tokens, web_search_calls, cost_usd, latency_ms, started_at, completed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{feature}, #{operation}, #{correlationId}, #{traceId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{status}, CAST(#{requestPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{responsePayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{errorPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{candidateCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{webSearchCalls}, #{costUsd}, #{latencyMs}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (feature, operation, correlation_id) WHERE correlation_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, trace_id = EXCLUDED.trace_id, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, model = EXCLUDED.model, status = EXCLUDED.status, request_payload = EXCLUDED.request_payload, response_payload = EXCLUDED.response_payload, error_payload = EXCLUDED.error_payload, candidate_count = EXCLUDED.candidate_count, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, total_tokens = EXCLUDED.total_tokens, cached_input_tokens = EXCLUDED.cached_input_tokens, web_search_calls = EXCLUDED.web_search_calls, cost_usd = EXCLUDED.cost_usd, latency_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_ms, started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at
mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, feature, operation, correlation_id AS correlationId, trace_id AS traceId, provider, model, status, candidate_count AS candidateCount, input_tokens AS inputTokens, output_tokens AS outputTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, cached_input_tokens AS cachedInputTokens, web_search_calls AS webSearchCalls, cost_usd AS costUsd, latency_ms AS latencyMs, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_api_calls
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT , request_payload::text AS requestPayload, response_payload::text AS responsePayload, error_payload::text AS errorPayload FROM ai_api_calls WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT feature, operation, provider, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PROCESSING')) AS failedCalls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cachedInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(web_search_calls), 0) AS webSearchCalls, COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS storedCostUsd, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpricedInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpricedCachedInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpricedOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(web_search_calls) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpricedWebSearchCalls, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs FROM ai_api_calls
GROUP BY feature, operation, provider, model ORDER BY storedCostUsd DESC, calls DESC
SELECT DISTINCT feature FROM ai_api_calls ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT DISTINCT model FROM ai_api_calls WHERE model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
